insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Kalista is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Kalista in 52/115 games (45%): 4 picks (3-1) and 48 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Gwen? They go K'Sante
insights.text: Gwen is a G1 favorite (12/42 G1s, played by Kiin). In the 38 later games where it was burned or banned, Kiin went to K'Sante (6/38) and Yorick (5/38).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 31 G3+ games, 58/155 picks (37%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 58 champs in G1s, 78 in G3+.
